title: Preserve Unicode credential redaction in the Go remote executors
notes: The Go credential sanitizer differs from the Python sanitizer on Unicode input. A local parity check with synthetic data reproduced the difference.
done_when: Run the same Unicode credential-redaction fixtures on Python and Go and check that both remote execution paths receive the redacted input.
result: Preserve Unicode credential redaction in the Go remote executors
evidence: Go and Python agreed on 28,882 synthetic redaction inputs. The Go OpenRouter request-body and task-runner stdin tests verify that Unicode codes are redacted before execution.
